title: Weather Forecast Workflow
titleZh: 天气查询与预报工作流

nodes.label: User Weather Request
nodes.descriptionZh: 接收地点与日期的天气查询请求

nodes.label: Extract Place & Time
nodes.description: Parse target city/location and forecast horizon without LLM call
nodes.descriptionZh: 零模型延迟提取目标地点与查询时间段

nodes.label: Location Disambiguation
nodes.description: Branch if location name is ambiguous
nodes.descriptionZh: 判断地点是否唯一或需要用户确认

nodes.label: Ask User to Clarify
nodes.description: Pause flow and ask which city/state the user means
nodes.descriptionZh: 暂停工作流，请用户确认具体省/州及城市
nodes.promptTemplate: Which {{vars.place}} do you mean? Please specify the state or country so I can fetch the right forecast.
nodes.promptTemplateZh: 请问您指的是哪个“{{vars.place}}”？请补充所在省份或国家以便查询准确天气。

nodes.label: Call Forecast Tool
nodes.description: Fetch current weather and forecast from MCP weather provider
nodes.descriptionZh: 直接调用天气 MCP 工具获取温度、降水与风力数据

nodes.label: Format Weather Brief
nodes.description: Answer with condition and temperature first, then rain/wind if relevant
nodes.descriptionZh: 优先呈现天气状况与温度，按需提示降雨或大风
